name: s4-g100-reversible-recognition-chamber
host: the surviving S3 real/matrix sheaf-localisation environment (aionq.sheaf)
forbidden_promotions: no AGI, consciousness or cognition claim
no claim that hypercomplex coordinates are superior (RET-S3-HYPERCOMPLEX_DIAGNOSIS)
no claim that this architecture is optimal (RET-S4-OPTIMAL_COGNITION)

worldlets.carrier: sheaf_transitions: one d x d orthogonal matrix per overlap
worldlets.boundary: observes only holonomy around basis cycles; never a per-overlap ground truth
worldlets.note: real_matrix and NOT quaternionic: the dimension-matched real representation is the primary, per the S3 governing constraint

worldlets.carrier: f2_cochain: candidate defect supports in F_2^E
worldlets.boundary: holds supports only; carries no transition values
typed_remainders: coset ambiguity: supports differing by a cut are indistinguishable

worldlets.carrier: aperture_box: (tau, kappa, beta) with declared bounds
worldlets.boundary: may propose and may not promote; has no handle on the evidence ledger

worldlets.carrier: evidence_lattice: P/A/M/H/S/R claims under the governance partial order
worldlets.boundary: may tag and may not generate; shares code and authorship with the other roles, so it is a correlated witness and says so
typed_remainders: semantic remainder: what a tag does not capture about the candidate

tendrils.forward_transport: holonomy readout: cycle basis -> obstruction mass vector
tendrils.return_transport: non-negative least-squares fit of edge magnitudes on a candidate support
lost_fields: the coboundary component of the defect
which element of the group the defect was

typed_remainder.note: a genuine cohomological remainder, distinct in type from the round-trip transport defect

tendrils.forward_transport: candidate support -> predicted cycle mass under the additive model
lost_fields: candidate co-occurrence structure once projected to a per-overlap belief

typed_remainder.metric_or_comparison: sum of squares of the fit residual

tendrils.forward_transport: aperture (tau, kappa, beta) -> a candidate population of size kappa
tendrils.return_transport: population dispersion and consistency -> susceptibility and instability signals
lost_fields: individual candidate identity on the return path: only aggregates return

typed_remainder.metric_or_comparison: dispersion of gluing scores weighted by explained fraction

tendrils.forward_transport: candidate metrics tuple -> deposit decision against the preregistered region
transformed_fields: six-component metric tuple -> one deposit type and tag
lost_fields: per-gate margins once the tag is issued

typed_remainder.metric_or_comparison: what the tag does not say about the candidate

tendrils.return_transport: provenance record -> the identical raw artifact reference

typed_remainder.metric_or_comparison: exact equality of the retained reference; defect is identically zero

tendrils.note: the invariant channel. This is the one edge that must be exactly reversible, and it is the null-loop test case.

tendrils.forward_transport: orthogonal gauge transform G applied to every transition
tendrils.return_transport: G inverse applied to every transition

typed_remainder.metric_or_comparison: Frobenius round-trip; defect is identically zero for orthogonal G

tendrils.note: the isometry case for theorem target P3

identity.carrier: the tuple (evidence ledger, correction history, provenance records)
identity.continuity_condition: the invariant channel T_evidence_to_audit is never throttled and its loop defect stays exactly zero
identity.funded_by: invariant_draw, which must not exceed refill_rate
identity.what_would_break_it: any code path that reduces invariant_draw under resource pressure; none exists in aionq.recognition.budget by construction

clocks.name: meso_consolidation
clocks.role: aperture update, resource charge, nest evaluation

hyperedges.constraint: a deposit requires the candidate (memory), its gluing evidence (evidence) and an authorizing witness outside the generating dependency closure (audit). No pair of these suffices.
the aperture responds to candidate dispersion AND explained obstruction fraction jointly; dispersion alone is noise and explained fraction alone is not susceptibility.

weaving.rule: a tendril is woven while it carries information the chamber uses

deweaving.rule: a tendril is retired with a stated reason and is recorded, never deleted

controls: C2 static candidate ensemble, no adaptive aperture
C3 adaptive aperture, no ordered flow

evidence.statement: loop defect is a nonnegative TransportDefect, typed, raw value retained
an exact left inverse gives zero loop defect
loop defect is invariant under conjugation by an isometry
indefinite invariant-channel survival requires invariant_draw <= refill_rate, inside the constant-rate model
a claim cannot be promoted when every authorizing node lies in the dependency closure of the generating nodes
an adaptive aperture reveals structure a static ensemble does not
evidence.kill_condition: C2 static ensemble matches the complete effect region

evidence.statement: explore-then-verify outperforms both unordered and reversed flow
evidence.kill_condition: C4 fails to beat C3 and C5 by at least +0.01 held-out AUROC

evidence.statement: the three fixed structured fields probe basin stability better than matched-spectrum surrogates
evidence.kill_condition: C7 matched surrogates match C6 within the preregistered margin

evidence.statement: the exploratory role potential; denotes aionq.recognition.roles.Explorer and nothing more
the gluing and verification role potential; denotes aionq.recognition.roles.Verifier and nothing more
the evidence-gated deposit predicate; denotes aionq.recognition.nest.nest_decision and nothing more

observables.name: neg_delta_compute
observables.carrier: wall seconds, peak KiB, candidate evaluations, parameter count

observables.name: neg_delta_instability
observables.carrier: worst-case AUROC change over representation attacks

observables.name: order_defect
observables.carrier: L1 on the per-overlap belief simplex

falsifiers.kill_if: the static ensemble C2 matches the complete effect region
equal-entropy random perturbation C1 or matched surrogate C7 matches the effect region
C4 does not outperform both C3 and C5 by at least +0.01 held-out AUROC
the effect disappears on held-out nerve families
the effect depends materially on vertex labels, edge order, cycle basis, gauge or encoding
the three fixed structured seeds work only under post-hoc selection
an ordinary confidence margin predicts useful susceptibility as well as the aperture observables
resource parity fails: wall clock above 2.0x or peak memory above 1.5x the best matched baseline
raw metrics reveal clipping, leakage or tautological validation
